 Early Voting for General Election 
 News Flash
 Early Voting for General Election
 CTN Coon Rapids
 Posted on October 21, 2026 
 Early voting started on Friday, Oct. 16 at Coon Rapids City Hall. Voters can now place their ballot directly into a voting machine, rather than use absentee ballot envelopes. In addition to regular business hours (Monday-Friday from 8 a.m. to 4:30 p.m.), additional early voting hours include:
 -Saturday, Oct. 24 - 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
-Tuesday, Oct. 27 - 8 a.m. to 7 p.m.
-Saturday, Oct. 31 - 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
-Sunday, Nov. 1 - 9 a.m. to 3 p.m.
-Monday, Nov. 2 - 8 a.m. to 5 p.m.
 More early voting information .
The general election is on Tuesday, Nov. 3. Polls will be open from 7 a.m. to 8 p.m. on Election Day.
